response.title: Discount calculation rules
response.description:
1. Round discounted totals to 2 decimal places using round-half-to-even (banker's rounding).
2. Cap the discount percentage at the maximum allowed by the feature flag `checkout.max_discount_pct` (use the production value; marketing changes it occasionally, so hard-code the current value for now and leave a comment).
3. A negative percentage is a programming error: raise ValueError.
